# claude-multi

> Run multiple isolated Claude Code instances side by side. Each one gets its own provider, config directory, plugins, MCP servers, and `claude-<name>` command.

## What it does

claude-multi wraps the existing `claude` binary without forking or patching it. Each instance gets a wrapper script at `~/.local/bin/claude-<name>` that sets `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` before exec-ing the real `claude` binary. Instance metadata lives in `~/.claude-multi/config.json`.

This lets you run Claude Code against different providers (GLM/Z.ai, MiniMax, DeepSeek, Xiaomi MiMo, Moonshot Kimi, Alibaba Qwen) or different configurations without editing settings by hand.

## Installation

```bash
bun install -g claude-multi
# or: npm install -g claude-multi
# or: pnpm install -g claude-multi
```

Requires Node.js 22+ or Bun 1+, and Claude Code installed globally.

## Commands

- `claude-multi`: Launch interactive terminal UI (default)
- `claude-multi add <name>`: Create instance (flags: `--provider`, `--api-key`, `--region`, `--copy-settings`, `--copy-mcp`, `--copy-all`, `--skip-prompts`, `--sync-mode`; legacy aliases `--auto-sync`, `--half-manual`, `--manual`)
- `claude-multi remove <name>`: Remove instance (`--force` to skip confirm)
- `claude-multi list`: List all instances
- `claude-multi info <name>`: Show instance details
- `claude-multi doctor check`: Find wrapper, settings, and provider template issues
- `claude-multi doctor fix`: Back up, apply pending instance migrations, and refresh provider template env vars
- `claude-multi version`: Check for Claude Code updates
- `claude-multi update`: Update Claude Code to latest
- `claude-multi auto-sync <name> <mode>`: Set plugin/skill sync mode (`auto`, `half-manual`, or `full-manual`)
- `claude-multi fix-symlinks`: Fix broken symlinks (`-a` for all)
- `claude-multi plugins <action>`: Plugin management (list, enable, disable, copy, install, remove, list-defaults, list-installed, check-collisions)
- `claude-multi mcp <action>`: MCP management (list, copy, verify)

## Provider templates

| Provider | Endpoint | Models |
|----------|----------|--------|
| GLM Coding Plan | api.z.ai | glm-5.3[1m], glm-5.3-flash[1m] |
| MiniMax | api.minimax.io | MiniMax-M3.1-Flash[1m] |
| DeepSeek | api.deepseek.com | deepseek-flash[1m] (primary/opus/sonnet/fable), deepseek-flash (haiku/subagents), deepseek-v4-pro[1m] (optional) |
| Xiaomi MiMo | api.xiaomimimo.com | mimo-v2.6-pro[1m], mimo-v2.6-flash[1m] |
| Xiaomi MiMo (Token Plan) | token-plan-cn.xiaomimimo.com | mimo-v2.6-pro[1m], mimo-v2.6-flash[1m] |
| Moonshot Kimi | api.moonshot.ai | kimi-k3.1-pro[1m] |
| Alibaba Qwen | dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com | qwen3.8-max, qwen3.7-plus, qwen3.8-flash |
| Alibaba Qwen Coding Plan | coding-intl.dashscope.aliyuncs.com | qwen3.7-plus |

All providers use the Anthropic-compatible API format with their own base URL.

Every template maps `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL` to its primary model so the `fable` alias never sends `claude-fable-5-1` to a third-party endpoint. GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, and Kimi also set `CLAUDE_CODE_ALWAYS_ENABLE_EFFORT=1` so their effort level reaches Claude Code for custom model IDs.

Existing instances do not update their provider settings in the background. After upgrading claude-multi, run `claude-multi doctor check`, then `claude-multi doctor fix` to apply pending template changes. The sync updates model slots and other template settings, while keeping API keys and custom tunables unless a documented legacy default needs an upgrade.

## Key concepts

- **Instances**: Named Claude Code configs stored in `~/.claude-<name>/`
- **Auto-sync**: Symlinks entire `plugins/` and `skills/` directories from `~/.claude/` into each instance
- **Half-manual**: Symlinks individual plugins and skills, so new installs stay isolated
- **Full-manual**: Copies files instead of symlinking for full isolation
- **Plugin management**: Install/remove individual plugins with MCP collision detection and rollback
- **Health checks**: Detects broken symlinks, missing dirs, corrupted settings, failed migrations
- **Migration system**: Version and provider template checks with backups and file locking

## File locations

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `~/.claude-multi/config.json` | Instance registry |
| `~/.claude-<name>/` | Per-instance config directory |
| `~/.local/bin/claude-<name>` | Wrapper command |
| `~/.claude/` | Default Claude Code config (source for copy/sync) |

## Tech stack

TypeScript (ESNext, strict, ESM) · Bun bundler · Commander.js CLI · Ink v7 TUI (React for terminals) · Unit, integration, and end-to-end tests · Cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows)
